panels.title: Players
panels.description: distinct human relay identities matching the filters

targets.queryText: SELECT count(DISTINCT p.username) AS players FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 AND ('$format' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.format, 'unknown') = '$format') AND ('$engine' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.engine, 'unknown') = '$engine') AND ('$hosted' = 'all' OR g.hosted = CAST('$hosted' AS INTEGER)) AND ('$official' = 'all' OR g.official = CAST('$official' AS INTEGER))

panels.title: Games / player
panels.description: average games per active human identity

targets.queryText: SELECT round(1.0 * count(DISTINCT g.game_id) / nullif(count(DISTINCT p.username), 0), 2) AS games_per_player FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 AND ('$format' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.format, 'unknown') = '$format') AND ('$engine' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.engine, 'unknown') = '$engine') AND ('$hosted' = 'all' OR g.hosted = CAST('$hosted' AS INTEGER)) AND ('$official' = 'all' OR g.official = CAST('$official' AS INTEGER))

targets.queryText: WITH ranged AS (SELECT duration_s FROM games g WHERE duration_s IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 AND ('$format' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.format, 'unknown') = '$format') AND ('$engine' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.engine, 'unknown') = '$engine') AND ('$hosted' = 'all' OR g.hosted = CAST('$hosted' AS INTEGER)) AND ('$official' = 'all' OR g.official = CAST('$official' AS INTEGER))) SELECT round((SELECT duration_s FROM ranged ORDER BY duration_s LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT count(*) / 2 FROM ranged)) / 60.0, 1) AS minutes

panels.title: Games and players
panels.description: daily games and distinct human players matching the filters

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(g.started_at)) AS INTEGER) AS t, count(DISTINCT g.game_id) AS games, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.is_bot = 0 THEN p.username END) AS players FROM games g LEFT JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 AND ('$format' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.format, 'unknown') = '$format') AND ('$engine' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.engine, 'unknown') = '$engine') AND ('$hosted' = 'all' OR g.hosted = CAST('$hosted' AS INTEGER)) AND ('$official' = 'all' OR g.official = CAST('$official' AS INTEGER)) GROUP BY date(g.started_at) ORDER BY date(g.started_at)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(g.started_at)) AS INTEGER) AS t, count(DISTINCT g.game_id) AS games, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.is_bot = 0 THEN p.username END) AS players FROM games g LEFT JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 AND ('$format' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.format, 'unknown') = '$format') AND ('$engine' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.engine, 'unknown') = '$engine') AND ('$hosted' = 'all' OR g.hosted = CAST('$hosted' AS INTEGER)) AND ('$official' = 'all' OR g.official = CAST('$official' AS INTEGER)) GROUP BY date(g.started_at) ORDER BY date(g.started_at)

panels.title: Seven-day return rate by first-play cohort
panels.description: share of new players who play again 1–7 days after first appearance; recent cohorts are incomplete

targets.queryText: WITH activity AS (SELECT p.username, date(g.started_at) AS day FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND ('$format' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.format, 'unknown') = '$format') AND ('$engine' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.engine, 'unknown') = '$engine') AND ('$hosted' = 'all' OR g.hosted = CAST('$hosted' AS INTEGER)) AND ('$official' = 'all' OR g.official = CAST('$official' AS INTEGER)) GROUP BY 1, 2), first_seen AS (SELECT username, min(day) AS cohort FROM activity GROUP BY username) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', f.cohort) AS INTEGER) AS t, round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity a WHERE a.username = f.username AND a.day > f.cohort AND a.day <= date(f.cohort, '+7 day')) THEN 1 END) / count(*), 1) AS return_pct FROM first_seen f WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', f.cohort) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', f.cohort) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY f.cohort ORDER BY f.cohort
targets.rawQueryText: WITH activity AS (SELECT p.username, date(g.started_at) AS day FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND ('$format' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.format, 'unknown') = '$format') AND ('$engine' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.engine, 'unknown') = '$engine') AND ('$hosted' = 'all' OR g.hosted = CAST('$hosted' AS INTEGER)) AND ('$official' = 'all' OR g.official = CAST('$official' AS INTEGER)) GROUP BY 1, 2), first_seen AS (SELECT username, min(day) AS cohort FROM activity GROUP BY username) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', f.cohort) AS INTEGER) AS t, round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity a WHERE a.username = f.username AND a.day > f.cohort AND a.day <= date(f.cohort, '+7 day')) THEN 1 END) / count(*), 1) AS return_pct FROM first_seen f WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', f.cohort) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', f.cohort) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY f.cohort ORDER BY f.cohort

panels.title: Player frequency
panels.description: anonymous distribution of games per human identity

targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN games = 1 THEN '1' WHEN games < 5 THEN '2-4' WHEN games < 10 THEN '5-9' ELSE '10+' END AS activity, count(*) AS players, min(games) AS ord FROM (SELECT p.username, count(DISTINCT g.game_id) AS games FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 AND ('$format' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.format, 'unknown') = '$format') AND ('$engine' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.engine, 'unknown') = '$engine') AND ('$hosted' = 'all' OR g.hosted = CAST('$hosted' AS INTEGER)) AND ('$official' = 'all' OR g.official = CAST('$official' AS INTEGER)) GROUP BY p.username) GROUP BY activity ORDER BY ord
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN games = 1 THEN '1' WHEN games < 5 THEN '2-4' WHEN games < 10 THEN '5-9' ELSE '10+' END AS activity, count(*) AS players, min(games) AS ord FROM (SELECT p.username, count(DISTINCT g.game_id) AS games FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 AND ('$format' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.format, 'unknown') = '$format') AND ('$engine' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.engine, 'unknown') = '$engine') AND ('$hosted' = 'all' OR g.hosted = CAST('$hosted' AS INTEGER)) AND ('$official' = 'all' OR g.official = CAST('$official' AS INTEGER)) GROUP BY p.username) GROUP BY activity ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Game duration distribution
panels.description: duration buckets for matching ended games

targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN duration_s < 180 THEN '<3m' WHEN duration_s < 600 THEN '3–10m' WHEN duration_s < 1200 THEN '10–20m' WHEN duration_s < 1800 THEN '20–30m' WHEN duration_s < 3600 THEN '30–60m' ELSE '60m+' END AS duration, count(*) AS games, min(duration_s) AS ord FROM games g WHERE duration_s IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 AND ('$format' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.format, 'unknown') = '$format') AND ('$engine' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.engine, 'unknown') = '$engine') AND ('$hosted' = 'all' OR g.hosted = CAST('$hosted' AS INTEGER)) AND ('$official' = 'all' OR g.official = CAST('$official' AS INTEGER)) GROUP BY duration ORDER BY ord
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN duration_s < 180 THEN '<3m' WHEN duration_s < 600 THEN '3–10m' WHEN duration_s < 1200 THEN '10–20m' WHEN duration_s < 1800 THEN '20–30m' WHEN duration_s < 3600 THEN '30–60m' ELSE '60m+' END AS duration, count(*) AS games, min(duration_s) AS ord FROM games g WHERE duration_s IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 AND ('$format' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.format, 'unknown') = '$format') AND ('$engine' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.engine, 'unknown') = '$engine') AND ('$hosted' = 'all' OR g.hosted = CAST('$hosted' AS INTEGER)) AND ('$official' = 'all' OR g.official = CAST('$official' AS INTEGER)) GROUP BY duration ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Human participation
panels.description: number of human seats in matching games

targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN humans = 0 THEN 'bots only' WHEN humans = 1 THEN 'solo vs AI' WHEN humans = 2 THEN '2 humans' ELSE '3+ humans' END AS mode, count(*) AS games FROM (SELECT g.game_id, count(CASE WHEN p.is_bot = 0 THEN 1 END) AS humans FROM games g LEFT JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 AND ('$format' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.format, 'unknown') = '$format') AND ('$engine' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.engine, 'unknown') = '$engine') AND ('$hosted' = 'all' OR g.hosted = CAST('$hosted' AS INTEGER)) AND ('$official' = 'all' OR g.official = CAST('$official' AS INTEGER)) GROUP BY g.game_id) GROUP BY mode ORDER BY games DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN humans = 0 THEN 'bots only' WHEN humans = 1 THEN 'solo vs AI' WHEN humans = 2 THEN '2 humans' ELSE '3+ humans' END AS mode, count(*) AS games FROM (SELECT g.game_id, count(CASE WHEN p.is_bot = 0 THEN 1 END) AS humans FROM games g LEFT JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 AND ('$format' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.format, 'unknown') = '$format') AND ('$engine' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.engine, 'unknown') = '$engine') AND ('$hosted' = 'all' OR g.hosted = CAST('$hosted' AS INTEGER)) AND ('$official' = 'all' OR g.official = CAST('$official' AS INTEGER)) GROUP BY g.game_id) GROUP BY mode ORDER BY games DESC

panels.title: Non-game-over endings
panels.description: reasons matching games did not reach game over

targets.queryText: SELECT g.end_reason AS reason, count(*) AS games, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM games g WHERE g.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND g.game_over = 0 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 AND ('$format' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.format, 'unknown') = '$format') AND ('$engine' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.engine, 'unknown') = '$engine') AND ('$hosted' = 'all' OR g.hosted = CAST('$hosted' AS INTEGER)) AND ('$official' = 'all' OR g.official = CAST('$official' AS INTEGER)) GROUP BY g.end_reason ORDER BY games DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT g.end_reason AS reason, count(*) AS games, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM games g WHERE g.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND g.game_over = 0 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', g.started_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 AND ('$format' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.format, 'unknown') = '$format') AND ('$engine' = 'all' OR coalesce(g.engine, 'unknown') = '$engine') AND ('$hosted' = 'all' OR g.hosted = CAST('$hosted' AS INTEGER)) AND ('$official' = 'all' OR g.official = CAST('$official' AS INTEGER)) GROUP BY g.end_reason ORDER BY games DESC

panels.title: Users by platform
panels.description: distinct relay identities per platform; multi-platform users appear in each platform they used

targets.queryText: SELECT platform, count(DISTINCT username) AS users FROM client_connections WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', ts) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', ts) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY platform ORDER BY users DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT platform, count(DISTINCT username) AS users FROM client_connections WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', ts) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', ts) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY platform ORDER BY users DESC

panels.title: Daily users by platform
panels.description: distinct relay identities connecting each day; history begins with client-platform rollout

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(ts)) AS INTEGER) AS t, platform, count(DISTINCT username) AS users FROM client_connections WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', ts) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', ts) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY date(ts), platform ORDER BY date(ts), platform
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(ts)) AS INTEGER) AS t, platform, count(DISTINCT username) AS users FROM client_connections WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', ts) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', ts) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY date(ts), platform ORDER BY date(ts), platform
